name: The Pledge of the Pole
description: The counterpart to the pledge of earth, and colder. A shaft of pale wood stands in a socket of stone, guyed in four directions, and the ground around it is swept bare in a circle wider than the shaft is tall.

pois.label: Guy ropes
pois.text: Four ropes, four anchors, all taut. The rope nearest the wind is frayed almost through and has been re-knotted twice at the same place by different hands.

pois.label: Swept circle
pois.text: Bare ground with a clean edge. Outside it, grass. The sweeping is recent and the broom is leaning where it was left, bristles down.

pois.label: Socket stone
pois.text: Cut to take the shaft and cut deep. The rim is chipped in one place, and the chip sits in the grass a hand's width away, as though the stone was struck from inside.
